entities.summary: Karl Mathy was a performers & entertainers in Mannheim (1807-03-17, Mannheim – 1868-02-03) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
